master_blocks.text: Future: will and be going to
وقتی دربارهٔ آینده صحبت می‌کنیم، دو ساختار بسیار مهم این درس عبارت‌اند از:

items: will + base verb
am / is / are + going to + base verb

master_blocks.text: هر دو دربارهٔ آینده هستند، اما معمولاً دلیل انتخاب آن‌ها متفاوت است.

items: I will help.
She will protect nature.
They will travel tomorrow.

master_blocks.text: برای منفی: Subject + will not + base verb

items: I will not forget.
They won't destroy the forest.

master_blocks.text: برای سؤال: Will + subject + base verb ...?

items: Will you help me?
Will they visit the museum?

lines: ⭐ Golden Rule: بعد از will همیشه شکل سادهٔ فعل می‌آید.

items: will go ✓
will goes ✗
will going ✗
will to go ✗

من به تو کمک خواهم کرد.
نگران نباش. من به تو کمک خواهم کرد.

master_blocks.text: Subject + am/is/are + going to + base verb

items: I am going to study tonight.
She is going to visit the museum.

master_blocks.text: برای سؤال: Am/Is/Are + subject + going to + base verb...?

master_blocks.text: 5. When do we use be going to?
A. A plan or intention decided before now
اگر برنامه یا تصمیم از قبل وجود داشته باشد:

items: We bought the tickets yesterday.
We are going to travel next week.
Reza decided last year.
He is going to study biology.

master_blocks.text: B. A prediction based on present evidence
وقتی الان نشانه‌ای می‌بینیم که چیزی قرار است اتفاق بیفتد:

items: Look at those dark clouds!
It is going to rain.
Be careful! That box is going to fall.

master_blocks.text: این دو جمله را با دقت مقایسه کن:

items: The phone is ringing. I will answer it. → من همین الآن تصمیم گرفتم.
I bought a ticket yesterday. I am going to travel tomorrow. → این کار از قبل برنامه‌ریزی شده است.

master_blocks.text: قبل از انتخاب، از خودت بپرس:

items: آیا تصمیم همین الآن گرفته شد؟ → will
آیا برنامه از قبل وجود دارد؟ → be going to
آیا فقط یک نظر یا پیش‌بینی است؟ → معمولاً will
آیا اکنون نشانهٔ واضحی برای اتفاق آینده می‌بینم؟ → be going to

master_blocks.text: گاهی هر دو ساختار می‌توانند درست باشند:

In the future, there are going to be fewer wild animals.

master_blocks.text: وقتی تفاوتِ برنامه یا شواهد مشخصی وجود ندارد، هر دو می‌توانند پیش‌بینی آینده را بیان کنند.
ساختار: Wh-word + will + subject + base verb?

items: Who will visit Shiraz?

lines: ⭐ یادت باشد: بعد از will باز هم فعل ساده می‌آید.

master_blocks.text: 10. Future after if, when, before, after, as soon as
وقتی دربارهٔ آینده صحبت می‌کنیم، بعد از این کلمات معمولاً Present Simple می‌آید، نه will:

items: If + Present Simple, ... will + base verb
If people take care of cheetahs, their number will increase.
If we don't protect nature, animals will suffer.
When + Present Simple, ... will + base verb
When I finish school, I will travel around Iran.
As soon as it stops raining, we will go outside.
❌ If people will take care of animals...
✓ If people take care of animals...
Mistake 1 — ❌ She will goes to school. ✓ She will go to school.
Mistake 2 — ❌ I am go to visit my friend. ✓ I am going to visit my friend.
Mistake 3 — ❌ Will you going to come? ✓ Will you come? / Are you going to come?
Mistake 4 — ❌ If it will rain, we will stay home. ✓ If it rains, we will stay home.

master_blocks.text: در متن درس، انتخاب ساختار به معنی جمله کمک می‌کند:

items: We are going to protect their homes. → برنامه / قصد
The number will increase. → پیش‌بینی
If people take care of them... → بعد از if از حال ساده استفاده شده است.

master_blocks.text: قبل از رفتن به Practice، باید بتوانی این چهار سؤال را جواب بدهی:

items: بعد از will چه شکلی از فعل می‌آید؟

master_blocks.text: Adjective (صفت) کلمه‌ای است که اطلاعات بیشتری دربارهٔ یک اسم می‌دهد. صفت می‌تواند دربارهٔ این موارد اطلاعات بدهد:

items: اندازه: big, small
سن: old, young
رنگ: red, blue
کیفیت یا نظر: beautiful, interesting
ملیت: Iranian, German
جنس: wooden, plastic
a beautiful flower
a small animal
an old tree

master_blocks.text: وقتی فقط دو چیز را مقایسه می‌کنیم، از comparative استفاده می‌کنیم. برای بسیاری از صفت‌های کوتاه: adjective + er + than

items: tall → taller than
small → smaller than
young → younger than
Damavand is taller than Dena.

lines: ⭐ نشانهٔ مهم comparative معمولاً than است.

master_blocks.text: وقتی یک چیز را با یک گروه مقایسه می‌کنیم و می‌گوییم «بزرگ‌ترین، بهترین، مهم‌ترین»، از superlative استفاده می‌کنیم. برای بسیاری از صفت‌های کوتاه: the + adjective + est

items: tall → the tallest
small → the smallest
young → the youngest
Damavand is the tallest mountain in Iran.

master_blocks.text: برای بسیاری از صفت‌های بلند: more + adjective + than

items: more difficult than
more interesting than
more beautiful than
the most difficult
the most interesting
the most beautiful
This problem is more difficult than that one.
This is the most difficult problem in the book.
tall → taller → the tallest
fast → faster → the fastest

master_blocks.text: اگر صفت کوتاه به الگوی vowel + consonant ختم شود:

items: big → bigger → the biggest
hot → hotter → the hottest
large → larger → the largest
nice → nicer → the nicest
easy → easier → the easiest
happy → happier → the happiest

master_blocks.text: بعضی صفت‌ها قانون معمول را دنبال نمی‌کنند و باید شکل آن‌ها را یاد بگیریم:

items: ❌ gooder
✓ better

master_blocks.text: 8. The important words: than and the

items: Mars is smaller than Jupiter.
Jupiter is the largest planet.
❌ Jupiter is largest planet.
✓ Jupiter is the largest planet.

master_blocks.text: اگر دو چیز از نظر یک ویژگی برابر باشند: as + adjective + as

items: Tigers are as dangerous as lions.

master_blocks.text: اگر برابر نباشند: not as + adjective + as

items: This lake is not as deep as that one.
This car is not as expensive as that car.
یعنی: This car is cheaper than that car.

master_blocks.text: این دو را از هم جدا کن:

items: Comparative = دو چیز → Ali is taller than Reza.
Superlative = یک نفر/چیز در یک گروه → Ali is the tallest student in the class.

master_blocks.text: وقتی چند صفت قبل از یک اسم می‌آیند، ترتیب طبیعی معمولاً چنین است:
Opinion → Size → Age → Shape → Color → Nationality → Material → Noun

master_blocks.text: برای نشان دادن تغییر تدریجی: comparative + and + comparative

items: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

master_blocks.text: برای نشان دادن رابطهٔ دو تغییر: The + comparative, the + comparative

items: The bigger the animal, the more food it needs.
The more we protect nature, the safer animals will be.
❌ This book is more better. ✓ This book is better.
❌ Damavand is the most tall mountain. ✓ Damavand is the tallest mountain.
❌ This is more cheap than that. ✓ This is cheaper than that.
❌ Tigers are as dangerous than lions. ✓ Tigers are as dangerous as lions.
The human body is a real wonder. → adjective after be
one of the most important parts → superlative
red blood cells → adjective before noun
They are bigger than red cells. → comparative

simple_blocks.text: can, may, must, should افعال کمکی وجهی (modals) هستند که برای بیان توانایی، اجازه، اجبار یا توصیه به کار می‌روند.
بعد از این افعال همیشه فعل ساده می‌آید، نه فعل با s یا to.

تو باید با احتیاط رانندگی کنی.
همه باید به فرهنگ دیگران احترام بگذارند.

items: modal برای همهٔ فاعل‌ها (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) یکسان است و تغییر نمی‌کند.
بعد از modal هرگز to نمی‌آید.
✅ I can swim — ❌ I can to swim

simple_blocks.instruction: Complete with the correct modal (can, may, must, should):

items.sample_answer: When people get the flu, they must visit a doctor.
items.text: When people get the flu, they ______ visit a doctor.

items.sample_answer: It may rain.
items.text: There are many clouds in the sky. It ______ rain.

items.sample_answer: I should learn Spanish.
items.text: I like to travel to Spain. I ______ learn Spanish.

items.sample_answer: He must do more exercises.
items.text: He ______ do more exercises. His heart is very weak.

items.sample_answer: You should not listen to loud music.
items.text: You ______ listen to loud music. It hurts your ears.

simple_blocks.instruction: Ask a partner about things they can or cannot do, or should or should not do:

items.sample_answer: Yes, I can buy air tickets online.
items.text: Can you buy air tickets online?

items.sample_answer: Yes, you may use my pencil.
items.text: May I use your pencil?

items.sample_answer: Yes, my friend should help me.
items.text: Should your friend help you with your lessons?

items.sample_answer: Yes, I can swim.
items.text: Can you swim?

items.sample_answer: We must finish our English book before Khordad.
items.text: Must we finish our English book before Khordad?

simple_blocks.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct preposition (in, at, on, next to, in front of):

items.text: We usually travel ______ summer.
The plane leaves ______ 8 o'clock.
My cousin lives ______ Italy.
I will meet you ______ the bank.
There is a nice hotel ______ the station.

simple_blocks.instruction: Make sentences about things you should or should not do on a trip, using can, may, must, should:

items.sample_answer: On a trip, we should wear comfortable shoes.
items.text: Make a sentence about something you should do on a trip.

items.sample_answer: Tourists must not litter in nature.
items.text: Make a sentence about something you must not do on a trip.

items.sample_answer: We can take many photos of the wildlife.
items.text: Make a sentence about something you can do on a trip.

items.sample_answer: Travelers should respect local customs.
items.text: Make a sentence about respecting local customs.
